name: Progressive Yamhill
description: A nonpartisan, community-based network of Yamhill County residents working toward a region rooted in equity, inclusion, safety, and freedom from fear or hate, through education, civic engagement, and accountability efforts at the local and state level; founded in 2016.
registrationNote: Legal/registration status not stated on its own site; appears to operate as an unincorporated volunteer network rather than a registered 501(c)(3).
